concept: Recognizing the connection between physical state and mental/emotional state
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student notices their mood or focus shifting after a period of poor sleep, inactivity, or poor nutrition
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how to address the physical root of an emotional or mental symptom
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on the specific connection they noticed

assessment.success_marker: student identifies a specific, real connection between a physical habit and a mental/emotional effect
